mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level serves as a direct monetary policy indicator; higher rates compress equity valuation multiples through increased discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds historical 75th percentile, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering earnings revision downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation coefficient between UNRATE change and returns is positive in 40%+ of 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) indicate persistent inflationary pressures requiring aggressive tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of combined signal instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC remains below 0.03 across all 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.0% annualized), a 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as earnings expectations reset downward.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized AND INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the INDPRO signal's predictive power vanishes in late-cycle regimes (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS) above the 75th percentile indicate strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of high RSAFS instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 signals labor market tightness, accelerating wage pressures and inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between PAYEMS growth and returns is positive in 40%+ of 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts increase (HOUST > 1350) indicate sectoral misallocation from manufacturing to construction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through sectoral earnings volatility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction signal instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC remains below 0.03 across all 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation, low-rate regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 3.0%), market anticipation of aggressive easing drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days through yield curve steepening and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of regime instances, or the regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
